$Comment: The Mastery Trainer: the name, picture and ranks of the game's reputation group of the same id
It climbs the seven shared ranks like any reputation, then keeps going. Ranks names each shared rank
for the trainer alone (Newcomer up to Master), and each entry with a From is a rank of its own that
starts at that much earned standing: Master II, Master III and Grandmaster. Every From sits above
Exalted's floor, so the shared ranks keep theirs. A lock on any of these ranks reads the name written
here with the reputation's name. The rank ids are saved progress: rename one and every player loses it.
Each rank from Friendly up pays mastery points through an achievement of its own in
Achievements/MMOSkillTree/Mastery/Trainer/, collected in the book, and Friendly, Revered, Exalted and
Mastery_Trainer_Tier_3 each open a slot on the trainer's board, Mmo_Mastery_Lessons.
Standing comes only from the Reputation rewards on the trainer's lessons and quests, so each card says
how much. There is no Kills group, no Gear group and no Cap, so standing keeps climbing past the top
rank, and no Beyond, since the Master's lessons are what keep paying at the top. Earn lists those
ways, one lang key a line, for the How to earn block on the Reputation page. Order 1 puts the trainer
near the top of the Reputation page.
